Look at what run_agent returns after the first call to chat(). If it returns immediately, you have an if-statement instead of a loop.
The loop must continue when response["type"] == "tool_call". After dispatching the tool, append {"role": "tool", "content": str(result)} to messages before calling chat() again.
The full pattern: while True: resp = chat(messages); if resp['type'] == 'tool_call': messages.append({...result...}); elif resp['type'] == 'text': return resp['content']
